name: Seated Cable Row
grip: Both hands grasp the parallel grips of one close row handle, palms facing each other.
description: Pull a close-grip handle toward the lower ribs from a seated position while keeping the torso steady.
setup: Attach a close row handle to one low cable and select the stack load.
Sit on the bench, brace both feet on the supports and keep a small knee bend.
Grasp the handle with both hands and sit tall at a distance that permits a controlled reach.
instructions: Begin with arms extended and the shoulders allowed to reach forward without rounding the lower back.
Pull the elbows back close to the sides as the handle approaches the lower ribs.
Allow the shoulder blades to move naturally; avoid exaggerated backward leaning.
Extend the arms slowly to return without dropping the stack.
commonMistakes: Rocking the whole torso to move the load.
Shrugging or pulling the handle high toward the neck.

logging.example: A single stack selected at 20 kg: record 20 kg on that machine.
logging.note: Record the selected stack value, attachment and pulley setup. Pulley ratios and machine calibration make stack values unsuitable for direct comparisons across machines.

alternatives: Seated Cable Row with Wrist Cuffs
